set.body:
Objective
Make all 11 fmrireg vignettes scientifically correct, deterministic, source-current, executable, cogent, and publication-quality.

Contract
- Repair package, dataset, or algorithm defects before rewriting prose around bad output.
- Every numerical, fidelity, performance, and inference claim must be supported by rendered evidence.
- Teaching code uses the current public API; compatibility internals are not presented as the preferred surface.
- Known-ground-truth examples use exact or tolerance-based oracles, not correlation alone.
- Expected warnings are explained or asserted; blanket suppression cannot hide semantic failures.

Non-goals
- A general fmri_lm interface redesign.
- Unrelated README, Rd, or release work.
- New statistical methods beyond what is required to make existing vignette claims honest.

Completion gates
1. All 11 vignettes render twice consecutively in fresh R sessions from the current source checkout.
2. Focused tests enforce voxel-term alignment, noiseless benchmark recovery, valid group contrasts, sketch fidelity, controlled-SNR comparability, and calibrated connectivity claims.
3. Every generated figure is visually reviewed after the final render.
4. The full pkgdown article site builds with working article navigation and no stale APIs.
5. The audit findings are reconciled explicitly; unsupported claims are removed or qualified.
6. Verification records exact commands, current HEAD, and any unrelated package-check limitations.
set.title: EPIC: vignette correctness and excellence
